source.title: FULL MATCH | Tomokazu Harimoto vs Lin Yun-Ju | MS SF | WTT Champions Doha 2026
source.capture: Saved browser screenshots from an earlier verified playback

title.zh: 低重心準備：腳、髖與自由手
title.en: Ready balance: feet, hips and free arm

notes.zh: 林昀儒雙膝彎曲、身體前傾，拍子留在身體前方。這個形狀能往左右移動，不能只把腰折下去、腿保持直立。
notes.en: Lin bends the knees and leans forward with the paddle in front. This stance leaves room to move; bending only the waist would not reproduce it.

notes.zh: 自由手用來平衡身體，不是每板都固定端在胸前。張本遠端下半身受到球桌遮擋，此張不適合比較兩人的精確膝角。
notes.en: The free arm balances the body rather than staying fixed at the chest. The table obscures Harimoto’s lower body, so this frame cannot support exact knee-angle comparisons.

title.zh: 手肘留空間，擊球後仍能銜接
title.en: Space around the elbow supports the next stroke

notes.zh: 張本右臂呈緊湊彎肘，拍子靠近身體前方；林的左臂也保留彎曲。遊戲應表現肘先預備、前臂再送出，而非直臂左右甩。
notes.en: Harimoto’s right arm is compact and bent; Lin’s left arm also retains bend. The animation needs elbow preparation and forearm delivery rather than a rigid arm swinging sideways.

notes.zh: 林已回到較低的準備位置，兩腳提供支撐。這裡可看出還原不是把球拍突然拉回固定座標，而是全身重新準備。
notes.en: Lin has regained a low ready position with both feet supporting him. Recovery is a whole-body reset, not snapping the paddle back to one coordinate.

title.zh: 移動後回擊：腳步與自由手一起動
title.en: Movement and the free arm accompany the return

notes.zh: 林正在移動回擊，兩腳的位置改變，自由手向相反方向伸出來平衡；人物不能沿地板滑動、雙腳始終貼死。
notes.en: Lin changes his foot positions while the free arm extends to counterbalance the moving return. A character sliding with both feet glued down would miss this coordination.

notes.zh: 此張有明顯動態模糊，適合看全身動作方向；拍面、握拍和精確觸球位置無法由這張單圖確定。搭配前後影格與原片看動作。
notes.en: Motion blur makes this useful for whole-body direction, while paddle face, grip and precise impact remain unresolved. Read it together with adjacent frames and the source replay.
